python - <<'EOF'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("tests/test_generate.py")
src = p.read_text()
src = src.replace(
"""from lumen_sdk import LumenAPIError, LumenRateLimited

from pixforge.billing import get_balance
from pixforge.features.generate import generate_image
from pixforge.images import list_images
""",
"""from datetime import datetime, timezone

from lumen_sdk import LumenAPIError, LumenRateLimited

from pixforge import clock, quota
from pixforge.billing import get_balance
from pixforge.features.generate import generate_image
from pixforge.images import list_images
""", 1)
src += '''

def test_free_user_gets_five_images_per_day(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    sixth = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5")
    assert not sixth["ok"]
    assert sixth["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert sixth["job_id"] is None
    assert "5" in sixth["message"]
    assert len(lumen.calls) == 5
    assert get_balance(conn, user_id) == 90


def test_limit_message_is_localized(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    response = generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5", locale="ru")
    assert response["error_code"] == "daily_image_limit"
    assert response["message"].startswith("Вы достигли лимита")
    assert "5 изображений" in response["message"]


def test_image_limit_resets_at_next_utc_day(conn, lumen, user_id):
    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 1, 23, 59, 59, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    for i in range(5):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-5")["ok"]

    clock.set_now(datetime(2026, 3, 2, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-6")["ok"]


def test_pro_user_is_not_limited(conn, lumen, pro_user_id):
    for i in range(7):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, pro_user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, pro_user_id, "image") == 0


def test_retry_does_not_consume_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    for _ in range(3):
        generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 1


def test_failed_generation_gives_quota_back(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.fail_with = LumenAPIError(500, "internal", "boom")
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-1")["ok"]
    lumen.filter_next = True
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-2")["ok"]
    lumen.fail_with = LumenRateLimited(5)
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-3")["ok"]
    assert quota.used(conn, user_id, "image") == 0


def test_failures_do_not_block_the_free_quota(conn, lumen, user_id):
    lumen.filter_next = True
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-0")["ok"]
    for i in range(1, 6):
        assert generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", f"req-{i}")["ok"]
    assert not generate_image(conn, lumen, user_id, "a cat", "req-6")["ok"]
'''
p.write_text(src)
EOF
python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -30
